warning: These are invented demo thresholds to populate UI states, not bank policy from the supplied agreements. Align rule names and scoring with the application's actual pre-qualification engine before using the seed in integration tests.
scoring: Sum score_contribution across six rules; maximum 100.

rules.name: annual_revenue
rules.points: 15 if revenue >= INR 5,000,000; 12 if >= INR 2,500,000; 8 if >= INR 1,000,000; otherwise 0

rules.name: monthly_emi_capacity
rules.points: 15 if capacity >= INR 150,000; 12 if >= INR 100,000; 8 if >= INR 50,000; 4 if >= INR 25,000; otherwise 0

rules.name: loan_to_revenue_ratio
rules.points: 15 if requested loan/revenue <=0.25; 12 if <=0.50; 8 if <=0.75; 4 if <=1.00; otherwise 0

rules.name: business_type_eligibility
rules.passed: business_type is in the demo allowlist

decision_bands.pass: score >=75 and first five pass checks pass
